style: Refined stylized realism; inhabited Breton summer; pale mineral plaster, slate, restrained blue/sage joinery and varied horticulture

proposed_quality.frontage_context: Derive window/sill/eave/base weathering from each target facade; retain fine physical-scale scan
proposed_quality.interiors: Every enterable building and furnished trailer retains room segmentation, service rooms, storage and decoration; distance tiers affect display detail, not whether rooms exist
proposed_quality.furniture: Semantic groups, coupled dimensions, facing/support relations and clear working fronts; reject door/stair/route overlap
proposed_quality.landscape: Terrain-conditioned canopy, understory, flowers and garden planting with deliberate clearings; preserve coast, graded pond banks and reserve paths/bridges/stairs
proposed_quality.export: Packed native source, shared-mesh GLB kits and chunk placement manifests; baked PBR, explicit UV scale, collision/navigation as separately verified products

upstream_references.integration: Design insights only; no upstream code copied, installed or executed by this compiler
